alerts.description: Northeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph possible.
Severe thunderstorms are expected with damaging winds up to 60 mph and quarter-size hail. Seek shelter immediately. Heavy rainfall may cause localized flooding in low-lying areas.

Persistent heavy rain may cause rivers and streams to rise above flood stage. Urban and small stream flooding is possible. Monitor forecasts and be prepared to take action if a flood warning is issued.
Periods of heavy snow and gusty winds may affect travel through Wednesday evening.
